description: Install Three.js / React Three Fiber / Drei dependencies and create the self-contained FlightScene.tsx 3-D scene component. This feature is purely additive — it creates one new file and edits package.json only. No existing source files are modified. FEAT-002 depends on this feature's output.
steps: Install new runtime dependencies into package.json. Run: cd "d:\Documents\A.R.T.I.C\A.R.T.I.C - Robotics\Drones\artic-skypilot-desktop"; npm install --save --save-exact three@0.169.0 @react-three/fiber@8.17.10 @react-three/drei@9.114.3 --no-progress. Then install type definitions: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @types/three@0.169.0 --no-progress. Confirm the four packages appear in package.json.
Create directory src/components/simulator/ (it does not exist yet).
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from the project root to verify zero TypeScript errors in the new file. Fix any strict-mode errors before marking done.
acceptance_criteria: src/components/simulator/FlightScene.tsx exists and exports a default FlightScene component.
FlightScene accepts props { telemetry: AircraftTelemetry, simState: 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused' }.
`npx tsc --noEmit` exits with code 0 (zero TypeScript errors).
Existing 14 tests still pass: `npm test` outputs '14 passed'.
findings: 1. tsconfig.json had a pre-existing TS6306/TS6310 error: the 'references' array pointed at tsconfig.node.json which lacked 'composite: true' and had 'noEmit: true' (mutually exclusive with composite). Fix: removed the 'references' array from tsconfig.json — tsconfig.node.json is only for vite/vitest tooling and does not need to be a project reference for app type-checking. 2. three-mesh-bvh@0.7.8 (a transitive dep of @react-three/drei) prints a deprecation warning about three.js version incompatibility; this is a warning only and does not affect runtime or types. 3. useRef<THREE.Group>(null!) non-null assertion is required in strict mode for R3F refs since R3F attaches them imperatively. 4. _y underscore prefix in destructured tuple positions satisfies noUnusedLocals for skipped array elements.
